reviews.review_title: Unresponsive and Unresolved — Still Waiting for My Refund
reviews.review_text: I recently upgraded my Toyota Yaris to a C-HR at FRF Toyota Swansea.As I didn’t have my V5C logbook at the time, I was told I had to pay a £250 deposit until I provided one. Fair enough.After contacting the DVLA, I was told I was no longer the owner and that FRF Swansea, as the current owner, must apply for the V5C themselves. I passed this information to the dealership immediately, even attaching a DVLA letter confirming it.Since then, I have sent multiple emails over several weeks, called the dealership, and even spoke to other staff members. My emails to Stephen (and later Rob) have gone unanswered, and my request for a refund has been completely ignored.This lack of communication and failure to resolve a simple matter is very disappointing. I expected far better customer service from a Toyota dealership.

reviews.author: Olu
reviews.review_title: Credit damage despite loyalty and clean history
reviews.review_text: I have been a loyal Toyota Finance customer for over 6 years with a perfect payment history — not a single missed or late payment. Unfortunately, my recent experience has been deeply disappointing and financially damaging.Due to a claim placed by Toyota Insurance (not by me), I was forced to return my vehicle. I did not initiate this claim, yet it impacted my insurance policy, and as a result, I returned the vehicle under a voluntary agreement. Despite this, Toyota Finance reported my account as delinquent to credit agencies — even after offering me a payment arrangement for the remaining balance.This is unfair and potentially unlawful under several consumer protection standards, including:🔹 The Consumer Credit Act 1974 (UK) / Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA – USA): These laws require accurate and fair reporting of consumer credit behavior. Reporting a delinquency while simultaneously offering a payment plan and knowing the customer has not defaulted in good faith may constitute unfair or inaccurate reporting.🔹 The Principles of Treating Customers Fairly (FCA – UK): Lenders must act in the best interest of the customer and treat them with fairness, particularly those in vulnerable or unexpected situations.As a result of this negative mark on my credit file, I have been declined finance by another vehicle dealer, even though the situation was not due to financial irresponsibility but rather an insurance-related technicality entirely out of my control. This damage is not only unjust — it is long-lasting.I am extremely disappointed that Toyota Finance, despite my long-standing, spotless history, chose to report my account in a way that severely impacts my ability to access credit. I am now pursuing options to escalate this through:A formal complaint to Toyota FinanceRaising a dispute with the credit reference agenciesSubmitting a complaint to the Financial Ombudsman Service (UK) or the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (USA)Seeking legal advice for defamation of creditLoyal customers deserve better — especially those who have upheld every part of their agreement. I urge Toyota Finance to reconsider their reporting decision and correct this unjust entry on my credit file.

reviews.author: CE Bower
reviews.review_title: Lease Buyout Nightmare
reviews.review_text: I have leased vehicles through Toyota/Lexus Financial Services for many decades, with no issues. They even gave me lease extensions during the COVID years, when I was reluctant to go car shopping--or anywhere!But I am writing about my current experience.My lease is up at the end of this month. I decided to buy the car, since leasing a new vehicle (same model, different year) would have cost nearly twice what I am currently paying--BEFORE the tariffs that are making America great and certain corporations and individuals wealthier--go into effect.  So I phoned Toyota Financial to get the buyout information and documents.First of all, the company is technologically in the dark ages. Maybe even prehistoric.Although they were able (at my insistence) to send me he paperwork I needed via email, I had to print, complete, and return the documents to them (by mail) along with a paper check for the buyout amount plus sales tax. They even sent me a form for California residents, though I live 3,000 miles from California.They are incapable or doing electronic bank transfers, accepting credit cards, etc. Just paper checks. (Fortunately, I still have a checkbook, but the last time I used it was 2007.)So, I did what I was supposed to do, and sent the documents and check to Toyota via Priority Mail.  Tracking indicated that it was delivered on 3/26.Eight days later, my bank records showed that the check still had not been cashed. I phoned the company, went through their annoying telephone menu, and after about 10 minutes, I got a "human" (and I use that word loosely) on the line. He was an arrogant and extremely unhelpful young man, whose only response to my inquiry about why my check had not been deposited was, "It takes 10 days for processing," and it was only day 8.  I imagine that for them, processing means opening the mail, then sending an employee to the bank to make deposits, since they are incapable of conducting business electronically.The rep could not or would not tell me how long it would take, once my documents were "processed, "for the bill of sale and title to be sent to me.And how would it be sent? By US mail, of course, which lately, in my experience, has been taking up to a full month for cards and letters to be delivered. They would not send my documents by Priority Mail. My only alternative was to pay an exorbitant fee for FedEx overnight service.It is now 4/5 or 11 days since Toyota received my check, and it still has not been deposited.To compound the absurd wait, Toyota will not transfer the existing vehicle registration to me, which means that I have to go to DMV and wait for hours to register the car in my name.  But wait....They have no way to inform me when the documents I need to register the car have been "processed" and mailed. The current registration, in the name of Toyota, is due in 3 weeks. In all likelihood, I will have to pay to renew the existing Toyota registration, then go to DMV and pay AGAIN to obtain new registration in my name.This is possibly the WORST customer service I have ever received in my life.I asked the arrogant customer disservice representative if he enjoyed working for a company that made things as difficult as possible for their clients, and he merely repeated that "processing takes 10 days."One more thing. I had been told a while ago that I could do the buyout through the dealership from which I had leased it. I thought that would simplify things and had intended to do that. However, when I met with someone at the dealership, I was informed that I would have to pay $900 in fees and various service charges for them to do the transaction--plus title and registration fees to the State. And they also would accept only cash or a paper check. Thanks, but no thanks.All I can say is, that if I ever want to lease a Toyota/Lexus vehicle again, it will be through a bank, NOT Toyota Financial Disservices.

reviews.author: Dean Cane
reviews.review_title: Toyota Financial Services Mafia
reviews.review_text: I attempted to pay off my car loan with Toyota Financial Services (TFS) on August 13, 2024, by sending in a check. However, at the beginning of September, I received a notification that I was behind on a loan payment. Concerned, I contacted Toyota Financial to inquire about the situation. During my call, a representative from TFS informed me that they had not received my check and that I needed to make a payment to avoid late fees.Initially, Toyota had informed me that they received the check, had processed my loan to a zero balance, and had released the lien on the title. However, about 30-40 days later (around September 23), after the check had been sent, they reestablished the loan and indicated that the payoff was not processed as originally agreed. Following this, I cancelled the check.M&T Bank has documented evidence showing that the payment was made. It appears that there was internal miscommunication at Toyota Financial, as one department reported receiving the payment while another did not. I have made multiple attempts to reach out to Toyota's customer service through my loan account, but their response was dismissive, only stating that I was behind on my payments. They provided no further assistance or clarification.After this incident, I received the free and clear title to the car about two weeks later, but despite this, I continued to face issues when trying to resolve the situation. I called Toyota multiple times, trying to pay off the loan for the original amount I had sent in August, minus the most recent payments. However, Toyota informed me that the payoff amount had increased and they would need to seek approval to potentially forgive the additional interest. This response was unacceptable to me, as there was no guarantee they would do so, and I felt Toyota was mishandling the situation. Their actions were damaging my credit, and I lost confidence in Toyota Financial Services' ability to resolve the issue fairly and competently.On December 13, I attempted to reach out again, but once again, I was met with unreasonable responses. TFS insisted that I allow the check to go through their process, which could take several months. I believe this is an unfair and unreasonable delay—especially given that any legitimate car loan service should be able to process a payoff within 30 days. It feels like I am being extorted for the additional interest by Toyota Financial Services, which is unacceptable.I have continued to make payments in September, October, November, and December, but I am still accruing interest, which is frustrating and unjust considering the error was on Toyota's part. Therefore, I am requesting that Toyota allow me to pay off the loan for the amount I initially attempted to pay in August and waive any interest that has accrued since then due to their mistake.If Toyota Financial Services continues to make things difficult, I will consider taking further action to regain ownership of the car without additional payments. I am questioning their legal claim to the loan or the vehicle, especially since they released the title to me. At this point, their behavior is more reminiscent of a coercive organization, not a legitimate financial service. They are preventing me from paying off my loan, damaging my credit, and jeopardizing my job due to my security clearance.I am seeking assistance from the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) to help resolve this matter and to investigate how many other individuals Toyota Financial Services may be mistreating with either their incompetence or what feels like extortion.

reviews.review_title: Paid off Loan and still no Lien Release Document
reviews.review_text: I paid off my vehicle in July 2023.....almost 12 weeks later I still do NOT have the lien release document needed to physically take into the DMV to obtain the title for my vehicle.  I called multiple times to inquire and I was told they are working on it and I should receive it in the mail soon. I called twice and it was only documented I called once about my title. The woman I spoke to the 3rd time today argued with me and then hung up on me.Also beware of the GAP insurance because they lied to me at the dealership at Elk Grove Toyota in California and told me once I paid down my loan and the value of my car was more than what I owed I could remove the GAP insurance.  This is a true statement except it DOESN'T lower your payment because they bundle the GAP insurance with the car loan and it is a fixed payment.  When I called Toyota the man I spoke to in the GAP insurance department told me it happens ALL THE TIME! They used tricky wording to deceive me into believing I could lower my monthly payment by removing the GAP insurance. I was so angry with Toyota when I found out they tricked me. Rotten Scammers!!!!

reviews.author: Charlene
reviews.review_title: Absolute shambles of a company
reviews.review_text: Absolute shambles of a company! They have errors with their direct debits and haven’t a clue what they recieved. Have got in touch with the financial ombudsman because although it was nearly handled, Denise contacted me and was completely incompetent and has left me no choice but to bring their errors further. Absolutely so not need this unnecessary stress and to think I was thinking of buying another new Toyota. Unbelievable! Avoid avoid avoid!!

reviews.author: Mr Anthony Dunn
reviews.review_title: Great service from start to end
reviews.review_text: Got a settlement fee instantly which was settled then financed another vehicle which I had a couple of issues caused by myself but ELENA sorted them out and kept in touch all the way through the process great service from start to finish thankyou

reviews.author: Stephen Bellhouse
reviews.review_title: Having just phoned for a settlment it…
reviews.review_text: Having just phoned for a settlment it is completely different from a week ago also was told completely wrong information about getting a payment refunded .Anybody thinking about toyota finance please choose another Brand they are totally useles after spending almost 70000 on 2 cars this will definitely the last Toyota we will buy!!!!!!!

reviews.author: customer
reviews.review_title: I bought my 2023 Corolla this March
reviews.review_text: I bought my 2023 Corolla this March. TFS had repeatedly not allowed for a setup of recurring payments for (4)months. Phone reps never solved the issue but took late payments. Negative credit report hits. No refund of late fees. Setup recurring and still charged late fee. Poorest service!

reviews.author: Daren Huntley
reviews.review_title: Be careful giving of this company with…
reviews.review_text: Be careful giving of this company with your details!I was going to get finance for a new car and gave this company my details for the loan.Did not have the loan in the end and the company will not clear my data from their records, they say that they have the right to keep my personal details for 6 years.Since giving them my information I been receiving lots of junk mail.There customer service is so unfriendly and unprofessional.

reviews.author: not_pablum
reviews.review_title: Title Documents Sent NO TRACKING USPS???????
reviews.review_text: We bought a new Toyota in February 2023 with a partial Toyota Financial loan ( 9+% interest rate, even though our scores are 800++) with the intent of paying it off in 4-5 month. We paid it off in July 2023.  They sent our title and payoff documents USPS STANDARD MAIL WITH NO TRACKING. WHAT???? This is, obviously, important documentation. WHY WOULD ANY RESPONSIBLE COMPANY DO THAT? One answer: MONEY. You've got to be kidding me.

reviews.author: Gerardo Rabulan
reviews.review_title: Inconsiderate customer service by…
reviews.review_text: Inconsiderate customer service by Steven over the phone. Jujy 13 at 10:00 am

reviews.author: Red Green
reviews.review_title: Toyota Financial Service Terrible
reviews.review_text: Toyota Financial Service charges higher than usual fees and interest rate. I suggest using a local bank or credit union. I have financed 3 vehicles with them and have owned 4 Toyota trucks. I have good credit and a perfect payment record on my current vehicle to date. Toyota sells to American but never the less, they offshore their services and fail to employ American inside the U.S. to serve the needs of United States residents for all their services. In the past, I have had to deal with them when I was unemployed and had a good relationship with them. Despite having a perfect payment record currently, I find the online and telephone customer services to be differcult to use and fustrating for a older person. Their customer service persons can be hard to understand and down right rude, sometimes. Toyota, generally makes a good vehile at a fair price. Their dealers are sometimes unethical, I have found in the past. I again, suggest dealing with a local bank or credit union that you do business with regularly to  to finance your major purchase. If you need to speak to a person, you can go right to the branch and see them face to face. You will be treated better as a person and get a better rate!

reviews.author: Lachance
reviews.review_title: After being a loyal Toyota patron for…
reviews.review_text: After being a loyal Toyota patron for 18 year and leased and purchased 6 vehicles. They judge me the covid time of late payment.   And refused to finance a leases payout that was way less than the value.

reviews.author: Graham Dobson
reviews.review_title: Very bad  service
reviews.review_text: This is very bad service. As my car was coming to  the end. I asked  for extra  payments  i was told yes no problem. Give all my  details. No problem  we will  send you a new contract. To sign. No contract come. AndTo day  they emptied are bank account. For the money for the last payment,,,I phoned to be told, my details WAS NOT UPDATED,,AT THE TIME. of my first phone call. Be  very careful about your details. Make sure that they have them.

reviews.review_text: 0 star if I could give! They owe me an overpaid check and never send me a refund. the people who answered my call, all of them are liars. I have already called more than 10 times, but still nothing. what a shame as a big company!

reviews.review_text: Customers Services appear lapse when you send an email direct to them, even when you use the online message service there is no actual reply. Traded my Toyota for another one, they still took a payment on the old agreement when it had already been settled. I eventually got my money back.

reviews.author: Sue Wainwright
reviews.review_title: My Toyota App is not fit for purpose
reviews.review_text: My Toyota App is not fit for purpose - cannot access every single time I try even after having successfully changed password.  Without fail, unable to access website.

reviews.author: andrew grant reed
reviews.review_title: Threatening my credit profile due to their own incompetence
reviews.review_text: I traded my CHR back to Toyota and picked up a new Aygo - some six weeks ago. TFS tried to take a further payment 3 weeks later and when I stopped it sent me a threatening letter seeking payment of the instalment and saying my credit profile could be damaged. I wrote back explaining and also wrote to the dealer in MK (who says they have passed on the paperwork). TFS have now said they will amend my credit profile once the dealer has passed the trade in payment on to them! This is between two Toyota offices and nothing to do with me, Dreadful!!

reviews.author: Alan Hodgins
reviews.review_title: Have won with the ombudsman after non…
reviews.review_text: Have won with the ombudsman after non functional vehicle has sat on my drive for 18months and still tfs have not bothered to respond to myself or the ombudsman.Next thing is to pursue court action with an N322A form which enforces the ombudsman decision in court allowing bailiff intervention.Case ID 000031917195

reviews.author: Ian
reviews.review_title: I have had two financial agreements…
reviews.review_text: I have had two financial agreements with this company over the past four years. Two running at the same time. Both have been settled early.I recently raised a complaint when they then refused to finance another car. I had nio response to the email, I then over the course of a few days, sent my complaint to two further different email addresses for Toyota Financial Services. I still have not even had an acknowledgment from them for any of the three emails.You would of thought, that having lined their pockets with business for the last four years, on two not one contracts, that they would have the decency to respond to a complaint, and at least offer some sort of excuse why they do not want to finance a new car now for me.very, very disappointed at the total lack of response/communication.

reviews.author: Paul Coady
reviews.review_title: I had to make 4 different calls to them…
reviews.review_text: I had to make 4 different calls to them this afternoon to get connected with a representative. Almost impossible to get away from the bot to get a person. I wanted to get a payoff letter from TFS so my bank can send them the pay off balance of my loan. Why I could not do this online through my TFS account is a mystery to me. The rep told me it would take 3 days to e mail the payoff info to my banker and that they had to mail me an authorization letter to sign and give to my bank. They could not e mail me the form only mail it and it would take 7 to 10 days. After signing it I could e mail it to my banker as it had to go along with the bank's payoff. It all appears to me to be Toyota's plan to get as much interest as they can before I can payoff the balance. Unbelievable that TFS does not have a better IT set up as all of this should be able to be done on line.

reviews.author: Ben Rosenberg
reviews.review_title: Lies or incompetence!
reviews.review_text: This company has lied a number of times about resolving an issue. Full amount of  finance paid, yet they have not removed my HPI marker which means I cannot proceed to start my new contract with my new car. Was told that they couldn’t the first time due to Experian being down, second time they said they would look into it and finally the third time, they said it would be resolved within 24-48 hours ago. 2 weeks later finance is being shown on my vehicle. Been on hold for near 30 minutes, absolutely disgraceful way to run a company!

reviews.author: Tammy Alicia Lewis
reviews.review_title: I’m suing these people for what their…
reviews.review_text: I’m suing these people for what their putting my son through with their stupid so-called  GAP insurance. I spoke with an attorney today about it. He informed me that in the height of Covid when all these financial institutions were so “so called” gracious in letting people defer payments to so-call help them in their time of need they neglect to tell the customer the fine print on what might happen on the back end of things! My son had a 2021 Toyota Supra his dream car that he got in a wreck and they totaled it out. He had GAP insurance. Now 5 months later Toyota financial sends him a letter saying he owes them $990 for a deferred payment he didn’t even ask for. They offered to do it for him. NOT telling him if something happened to his car that GAP wouldn’t cover any deferred payments!! He’s trying to buy another car now but can’t because he has this hanging over him! Toyota can either wipe this clean off his account with them or buy him another car free and clear by the time my lawyer is done with them!! Shame on you Toyota financial GAP for doing these kids this way especially during a time when we’re the most vulnerable!! 🤬🤬☹️🤨🤨

reviews.author: Mark Baird
reviews.review_title: Toyota Financial doesn't release titles
reviews.review_text: If you ask the rep at Toyota financial, they will tell you that it is their policy to release titles after a lien is paid off. Our family has owned a lot of Toyotas and I can say that has never happened once. You have to contact Toyota Financial and that is process is always awful. You can have them call you back rather than wait on hold but what I got out of that was a call from the company robot with no one on the other end, just silence. You can call back and stay on hold and listen to an awful twangy bit of country pop that repeats several times a minute and will burn itself into your brain. Finally talk to a human and he will tell you whatever he feels is right, you follow the steps and wait for the doc to arrive and after several weeks you call back and after ten minutes of more of that awful song designed to make you hang up, you get informed that you were misinformed and you need to fax different docs, which no one felt any obligation to inform you of until you personally go through the aggravation of calling back. Even worse, they insist of having the docs arrive by fax. Anyone still have a working fax machine? It will cost me about $40 to fax the docs that they didn't know they wanted until they rejected what they first asked for. My case was closed until I called back. What do we make of a company that markets itself for its advanced tech and hasn't figured out email by 2022? We've had to deal with this four times in the last 3 years. It's enough to make me think twice about ever signing up for this treatment by buying Toyota ever again.

reviews.author: Glenn
reviews.review_title: Due to covid 19 pandemic my work hours…
reviews.review_text: Due to covid 19 pandemic my work hours were cut as well as my fiancé loosing her job and the arrival of our newborn son has gotten really tight. Toyota deferred a few payments and things slowly went back to normal and I have never been late or missed a payment since. I asked again for the same courtesy after the truck had grave mechanical issues just hitting the 100k mark. Now with the covid resurgence and no longer being paid for the days we miss, money has got tight. I was denied, I have spoken with multiple friends in the same predicament and have been given courtesy by other lenders. I feel Toyota does not stand by it’s products and does not care about its customers, only the paycheck. My families Christmas was shot this year and just trying to pay my bills is getting tough. My company a large commercial mechanical contractor in NJ will discontinue use of Toyota Tundra vehicles and be going with Ford now. I am a combat veteran and hard working American and this will be my last Toyota vehicle. I just want others to know about Toyota financials incompassion and warn you before you spend 60k on their product like I did.
